Having achieved a more than satisfactory 
result in the GⅠ Hopeful Stakes, King Halo 
declared her intent to continue on the 
Classic Triple Crown path.

It is the dream stage that can only be 
challenged once in a lifetime... A 
grueling path that takes on the Satsuki 
Sho, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), 
and the Kikuka Sho.

And so, King Halo's next target was 
decided: the first leg of the Triple 
Crown—the Satsuki Sho.
